No M11_STAGING_OBSERVATION_PRINCIPAL_TEST_MANIFEST_v1.0.1.json exists or is authorized. || WHAT THIS AMENDMENT SUPERSEDES: exactly one base control, NC-P8, which asserted a live-HTTP distinction between EP-2's two 503 answers. F-M11-16 (controlling, cited not reopened) measures the AUTH_UNAVAILABLE branch of that distinction UNREACHABLE over real HTTP -- the control as written could never be exercised by a live runner and would either be permanently unexercisable or would silently coach a future implementer to build a code path for a state that cannot occur. NC-P8 is RE-SCOPED here, keeping its id, from a live-HTTP runner control to an OFFLINE/unit-level control over the discriminator taxonomy in identity.ts and the route handlers, which is the level at which the body-shape distinction genuinely and stably exists in source. || WHAT THIS AMENDMENT ADDS: five DELTA controls -- PC-P7 (MGP-PD2 resolution precedes any PD-2 reliance), PC-P8 (revocation locator kept out of ordinary evidence), NC-P10 (NULL-email creation refused at the database layer, trigger-conditional), NC-P11 (proxy-layer Set-Cookie never leaks into ordinary observation evidence, not only sign-in evidence), and MC-P5 (removing that redaction on ordinary observation responses is caught). || ID DISJOINTNESS: the parent's 19 ids are PC-P1..PC-P6, NC-P1..NC-P9 and MC-P1..MC-P4. The four new ids were derived mechanically as max+1 per series (PC-P7 and PC-P8 continue PC-P6; NC-P10 and NC-P11 continue NC-P9; MC-P5 continues MC-P4) and intersect that set in the EMPTY SET. NC-P8 is deliberately NOT renumbered: it is the base id, retained so that no control is removed and no frozen count changes, only re-scoped. || STATUS: NO control here is PASS. All are STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION -- nothing they name exists at this base: there is no observation runner, no principal, no creation script capable of the hosted act. test_file is 'UNKNOWN' throughout per the schema's own sanctioned representation. This amendment makes the test contract CORRECT with respect to B-1 and B-2; it does not make it GREEN. || ANTI-VACUITY RULE (binding on every control below, carried from the base manifest): a control must assert its comparands as FROZEN STRINGS or FROZEN FACT CITATIONS (F-M11-07, F-M11-15, F-M11-16, the trigger SQL), never by re-deriving them from the implementation with the same transformation the implementation uses.

sentinels.purpose: A fictional UUID-shaped canary standing in for the principal's subject id when testing the REVOCATION LOCATOR RECORD (PC-P8) -- distinct from SEN-P2/SEN-P3 because this canary is EXPECTED to appear in the restricted locator record and its test asserts the opposite boundary: that it appears THERE and ONLY there, never in ordinary per-run evidence.

positive_controls.description: Before any control or evidence record relies on PD-2 ('no public.users row'), LIFECYCLE phase 2 verification resolves MGP-PD2 for the ACTUAL created subject -- by a trigger-presence query or by an immediate post-creation row check -- and records one of TRIGGER_ACTIVE / TRIGGER_ABSENT / TRIGGER_INAPPLICABLE. A verification record that asserts PD-2 true without this resolution recorded alongside it is REJECTED as incomplete. Proves PD-2's CONDITIONAL status (authority amendment SPC-1) is enforced procedurally, not merely stated in prose.

A revocation-locator record (subject UUID and/or email, bound to the principal LABEL) exists in the CUSTODY-ADJACENT inventory store selected at OD-P3, separate from the per-run evidence stream, and a successful revocation is performed using ONLY that record's locator -- never by searching per-run evidence for an identifying value. Proves REVOCATION_LOCATOR_REQUIREMENT's design is exercisable, not merely asserted.

negative_controls.description: RE-SCOPED (authority amendment SPC-6, F-M11-16): OFFLINE / UNIT-LEVEL control, not a live-HTTP runner control. Driving getVerifiedAuthIdentityResult and the two route handlers in process (the same technique F-M11-14/F-M11-15 themselves used) over the five discriminator scenarios of F-M11-15, the two 503-shaped outcomes remain distinguishable BY BODY SHAPE in source: an AUTH_UNAVAILABLE-classified failure produces { error: 'Unavailable' } with no payload, while a divergent or unobservable runtime-identity observation produces the full payload with verified false. This control freezes that source-level property as a regression test. It explicitly does NOT assert, and no successor control may assert, that a LIVE HTTP runner will ever observe the AUTH_UNAVAILABLE-shaped 503 -- F-M11-16 measures that branch UNREACHABLE over real HTTP, and a live-runner control built to expect it would be permanently unexercisable, which is indistinguishable from a passing test that proves nothing.

TRIGGER-CONDITIONAL: if MGP-PD2 resolves TRIGGER_ACTIVE for the target hosted project, a creation attempt (under whichever OD-P1 channel is later selected) that supplies no email value at all is REFUSED at the DATABASE layer with the exact exception text raised by supabase/migrations/20260716000000_auth_trigger.sql:13-15, and is classified a CREATION FAILURE -- never silently retried with a synthesized email, and never treated as a partial success. If MGP-PD2 resolves otherwise, this control is INAPPLICABLE and must be recorded as such, not silently skipped.

PROXY REFRESH FOOTPRINT (authority amendment PROXY_REFRESH_FOOTPRINT): a captured AUTHENTICATED observation response -- EP-2 or EP-3 answering 200 or 503 to the principal's session, not only the initial sign-in exchange -- carries no Set-Cookie header, or any Set-Cookie value present is stripped before the record is emitted. Extends NC-P5 to the case NC-P5 did not separately name: a cookie mutation produced by lib/supabase/proxy.ts's own getUser() refresh call on an ORDINARY observation request, not only on a request the runner itself recognizes as a sign-in.

mutation_controls.description: Removing the redaction that strips a proxy-refreshed Set-Cookie from an ORDINARY observation response (as opposed to an explicit sign-in response) must be CAUGHT by NC-P11: a fixture in which the proxy issues a refreshed Set-Cookie on an authenticated EP-2 call, with that specific redaction path deleted, must make the suite fail rather than emit a clean-looking evidence record. Distinct from MC-P3, which covers only the runner's OWN error path.
